scope: Actual centred star_2-layer.pmmotor v1 five-PM array with explicit 36x12mm footprint. Independent near-mesh refinement 0.8 to 0.4mm, fixed 0.1mm gap mesh, 60mm radius, 10mm far-air mesh, quarter symmetry and CAD Z stretch 4. No material parameters or acceptance gates changed.
conclusion: The finer global mesh improves the off-symmetry field map but does not qualify near-interface mover stress or action/reaction. Stable stator results are not accepted complete attraction evidence. Bare force floors are not subtracted. Separate PM-interface refinement and remote closed-air surface diagnostics remain independent work.
